schema.description: Ontology for NY Penal Law offenses: classification + enhancement-reachability + attempt/conspiracy logic + source enumerated lists.
schema.axioms_note: Axioms are kept as documentation. Execution logic lives in crimetime/resolvers.py.

axioms.A2_isYOEligible: isYOEligible(x) <=> isCrime(x) AND classification(x) not in {ClassA_I_Felony, ClassA_II_Felony}  [CPL §720.10(2)(a) excludes Class A-I and A-II felonies]
axioms.A3_isVFO: isVFO(x) <=> classification(x) in {ClassB,ClassC,ClassD,ClassE}_Felony AND x.section in lists.VFO_LIST[matching class].sections  [see A11 for attempt resolution]
axioms.A4_isSMFEligible: isSMFEligible(x) <=> classification(x) == Felony AND x.section in lists.SMF_LIST.sections
axioms.A6_hasPredicateExposure: hasPredicateExposure(x) <=> classification(x) == Felony AND classification(x) != ClassA_I_Felony  [PL §70.06(1)(a) excludes only Class A-I; §70.06(3)(a)/(4)(a) has live second-felony-offender table entries for Class A-II, so A-II retains predicate exposure]
axioms.A9_classification_of_attempt: classification(attempt_of_y) is resolved by an ordered branching rule against target y, per PL 110.05: (1) if y.section in STAYS_A_I_LIST -> ClassA_I_Felony [no downgrade]; (2) else if y.classification == ClassA_II_Felony -> ClassA_II_Felony [no downgrade]; (3) else if y.classification == ClassA_I_Felony -> ClassB_Felony; (4) else if y.section == '200.00' -> ClassD_Felony [bribery 3rd override]; (5) else if y.section == '200.03' -> ClassC_Felony [bribery 2nd override]; (6) else if y.section == '200.04' AND subdivision == '2' -> ClassB_Felony [bribery 1st subd.2 override -- see A14 subdivisionSensitiveAsAttemptTarget]; (7) else -> standard one-class downgrade per STANDARD_DOWNGRADE_TABLE. Note: 125.26 (aggravated murder) is deliberately excluded from STAYS_A_I_LIST because the A-I-stays-A-I treatment applies only to subdivision 1, not the whole section -- see A14 subdivisionSensitiveAsAttemptTarget, do not add '125.26' as a flat entry here.
axioms.A10a_isAttempt: isAttempt(x) <=> x charged as attempt of completed offense y; attemptOf(x) = y
axioms.A10b_isConspiracy: isConspiracy(x) <=> x charged as conspiracy to commit completed offense y; conspiracyOf(x) = y  [Article 105 conspiracy degree sections are generically worded by target-crime severity, same pattern as Article 100 solicitation -- conspiracyOf is only set when the charge is tied to a SPECIFIC named completed offense, not for the generic degree definitions themselves]
axioms.A11_VFO_of_attempt: isVFO(attempt_of_y) <=> resolve against lists.VFO_LIST using one of: (a) y.section appears in some class's attemptOfSection array (named carve-out, e.g. attempt of 125.25/135.25/150.20 -> classB), or (b) y.classification's VFO class C has attemptOfClass containing y's actual VFO class (e.g. attempt of a classB VFO -> classC VFO via generic downgrade rule), or (c) y.section appears in classE's attemptOfSection_lesserIncluded (weapon-possession lesser-included carve-out). This requires a resolver function, not a flat membership check -- see lists.VFO_LIST structure.
axioms.A12_SMF_of_derivative: isSMFEligible(z) <=> (isAttempt(z) OR isConspiracy(z)) AND isSMFEligible(attemptOf(z) or conspiracyOf(z)) AND lists.SMF_LIST.includesAttemptsAndConspiracy
axioms.A13_HateCrime_of_derivative: isHateCrimeEligible(z) <=> (isAttempt(z) OR isConspiracy(z)) AND isHateCrimeEligible(attemptOf(z) or conspiracyOf(z)) AND lists.HATECRIME_LIST.includesAttemptsAndConspiracy
axioms.A14_subdivision_sensitive: Two independent axes: (a) OWN DERIVATION -- subdivisionSensitiveOwnDerivation=true means this offense's own memberOf/derived vary by subdivision when charged as a completed offense (e.g. 125.15: subd 1 SMF/HC-eligible, subd 3 not). Resolver selects subdivisions[n].memberOf/derived instead of the offense-level summary. (b) ATTEMPT TARGET -- subdivisionSensitiveAsAttemptTarget=true means A9's branch (6) or A1_STAYS_A_I_LIST logic treats subdivisions of this offense differently when it is cited as an attemptOf target (e.g. 125.26: only subd 1 stays ClassA_I per 110.05(1); 200.04: only subd 2 stays ClassB per 110.05(9)). Resolver selects subdivisions[n].attemptOverride.classification instead of applying A9's default branches to the offense's flat classification. These axes are independent; an offense may be true on one, both, or neither. Offense-level fields remain the fallback wherever the relevant flag is false.
axioms.A15_STAYS_A_I_LIST: Sections whose attempt classification stays ClassA_I_Felony per PL 110.05(1): ['125.27', '220.21', '220.43', '490.45', '490.55']. These are evaluated at A9 branch (1) before any downgrade.
axioms.A16_STANDARD_DOWNGRADE_TABLE: Default one-class downgrade per PL 110.05 when no override applies (A9 branch 7): ClassB_Felony → ClassC_Felony, ClassC_Felony → ClassD_Felony, ClassD_Felony → ClassE_Felony, ClassE_Felony → ClassA_Misdemeanor, ClassA_Misdemeanor → ClassB_Misdemeanor. ClassB_Misdemeanor has no entry — unverified what attempt of Class B misdemeanor resolves to. Flag as open until confirmed.
axioms.A17_hate_crime_bump: If isHateCrimeEligible(x) AND hate_crime_motivated answer == true → look up x.classification in sentencing_tables.hateCrimeBump → apply matching branch. Bump logic (how sentence changes) lives in ny_sentencing_tables.json, not here. Eligibility (whether the offense can be a hate crime) is owned by HATECRIME_LIST and the isHateCrimeEligible derived flag.

notes: STAYS_A_I_LIST: Sections whose attempt classification stays ClassA_I_Felony per PL 110.05(1). Evaluated at A9 branch (1) before any downgrade.

STANDARD_DOWNGRADE_TABLE: Default one-class downgrade per PL 110.05 when no override applies (A9 branch 7). ClassB_Misdemeanor has no entry — unverified what attempt of Class B misdemeanor resolves to. Flag as open until confirmed.
Resolver function signature: resolveAttemptClassification(targetSection, targetSubdivision=None) — targetSubdivision only consulted at A9 branch (6) and subdivision-sensitive A1 targets.

classB.attemptOfSection_note: attempt to commit these named Class A-I felonies is independently enumerated as Class B VFO

classC.attemptOfClass_note: attempt to commit any classB.sections offense is classC VFO

classD.attemptOfClass_note: attempt to commit any classC.sections offense is classD VFO

classE.attemptOfSection_lesserIncluded_note: attempt of 265.02 subdivisions 5/6/7/8 as a lesser included offense under CPL 220.20 is classE VFO

100.00.name: Criminal solicitation in the fifth degree
100.00.elements: Intent that another person engage in conduct constituting a crime; solicits/requests/commands/importunes/attempts to cause it.

100.05.name: Criminal solicitation in the fourth degree
100.05.elements: (1) Intent that another engage in conduct constituting a felony, solicits; OR (2) actor over 18, intent that a person under 16 engage in conduct constituting a crime, solicits.

100.08.name: Criminal solicitation in the third degree
100.08.elements: Actor over 18, intent that a person under 16 engage in conduct constituting a felony, solicits.

100.10.name: Criminal solicitation in the second degree
100.10.elements: Intent that another person engage in conduct constituting a class A felony, solicits.

100.13.name: Criminal solicitation in the first degree
100.13.elements: Actor over 18, intent that a person under 16 engage in conduct constituting a class A felony, solicits.

105.05.name: Conspiracy in the fifth degree
105.05.elements: Intent that conduct constituting: (1) a felony be performed, agrees with one or more persons to engage in or cause performance; or (2) a crime be performed, actor over 18, agrees with one or more persons under 16 to engage in or cause performance.

105.10.name: Conspiracy in the fourth degree
105.10.elements: Intent that conduct constituting: (1) a class B or class C felony be performed, agrees with one or more persons to engage in or cause performance; or (2) a felony be performed, actor over 18, agrees with one or more persons under 16 to engage in or cause performance; or (3) the felony of money laundering in the third degree (470.10) be performed, agrees with one or more persons to engage in or cause performance.

105.13.name: Conspiracy in the third degree
105.13.elements: Intent that conduct constituting a class B or class C felony be performed, actor over 18, agrees with one or more persons under 16 to engage in or cause performance.

125.15.name: Manslaughter in the second degree
125.15.elements: Recklessly causes death of another person; OR intentionally causes or aids another person to commit suicide.

1.elements: Recklessly causes death of another person.

3.elements: Intentionally causes or aids another person to commit suicide.

125.25.name: Murder in the second degree
125.25.elements: With intent to cause death of another person, causes death (ED defense applies); OR under circumstances evincing depraved indifference to human life, recklessly engages in conduct creating grave risk of death, causes death; OR commits/attempts robbery, burglary, kidnapping, arson, rape 1st, etc., and causes death (safe harbor defense applies); OR actor 18+, depraved indifference, creates grave risk of serious physical injury or death to person under 11, causes death; OR actor 18+, while committing rape 1st/2nd/3rd, sexual abuse 1st, aggravated sexual abuse, or incest against person under 14, intentionally causes death.

105.15.name: Conspiracy in the second degree
105.15.elements: Intent that conduct constituting a class A felony be performed; agrees with one or more persons to engage in or cause the performance of such conduct.

115.00.name: Criminal facilitation in the fourth degree
115.00.elements: Believing it probable that he is rendering aid to a person who intends to commit a crime, engages in conduct providing such person with means or opportunity for the commission thereof and which in fact aids such person to commit a felony; OR believing it probable that he is rendering aid to a person under 16 who intends to engage in conduct constituting a crime, actor over 18, engages in conduct providing such person with means or opportunity for commission thereof and which in fact aids such person to commit a crime.

115.01.name: Criminal facilitation in the third degree
115.01.elements: Believing it probable that he is rendering aid to a person under 16 who intends to engage in conduct constituting a felony, actor over 18, engages in conduct providing such person with means or opportunity for the commission thereof and which in fact aids such person to commit a felony.

115.05.name: Criminal facilitation in the second degree
115.05.elements: Believing it probable that he is rendering aid to a person who intends to commit a class A felony, engages in conduct providing such person with means or opportunity for the commission thereof and which in fact aids such person to commit such class A felony.

115.08.name: Criminal facilitation in the first degree
115.08.elements: Believing it probable that he is rendering aid to a person under 16 who intends to engage in conduct constituting a class A felony, actor over 18, engages in conduct providing such person with means or opportunity for the commission thereof and which in fact aids such person to commit such class A felony.

105.17.name: Conspiracy in the first degree
105.17.elements: Intent that conduct constituting a class A felony be performed, actor over 18, agrees with one or more persons under 16 to engage in or cause the performance of such conduct.

120.00.name: Assault in the third degree
120.00.elements: With intent to cause physical injury, causes injury; OR recklessly causes physical injury; OR with criminal negligence, causes physical injury by means of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument.

120.01.name: Reckless assault of a child by a child day care provider
120.01.elements: Being a child day care provider or employee thereof, recklessly causes serious physical injury to a child under the care of such provider or employee who is less than 11 years of age.

120.02.name: Reckless assault of a child
120.02.elements: Actor 18+, recklessly causes serious physical injury to the brain of a child less than 5 years old by shaking, or by slamming/throwing the child so as to impact the child's head on a hard surface or object.

120.03.name: Vehicular assault in the second degree
120.03.elements: Causes serious physical injury to another person while: (1) operating motor vehicle/vessel in violation of VTL §1192(2-4a) or NAV §49-a(2)(b-e) while intoxicated/impaired; (2) operating commercial vehicle (>18k lbs) with flammable gas/radioactive materials/explosives in violation of VTL §1192(1) while impaired by alcohol; or (3) operating snowmobile/ATV in violation of Parks §25.24(1)(b-d) or §2281(a) of VTL in violation of VTL §1192(2-4a) while intoxicated/impaired.

120.04.name: Vehicular assault in the first degree
120.04.elements: Commits vehicular assault in the second degree (§120.03) AND: (1) commits such crime while operating a motor vehicle or vessel with a prior conviction within the preceding 10 years for DWI-related offense or vehicular assault/manslaughter/homicide; OR (2) causes serious physical injury to more than one other person; OR (3) while committing the offense, operates the motor vehicle or vessel while knowing he has a blood alcohol content of 0.18 or more; OR (4) while committing the offense, operates a motor vehicle or vessel with a child under 15 as a passenger; OR (5) causes serious physical injury to a police officer, peace officer, firefighter, paramedic, EMT, or other specified emergency personnel while on duty.

120.04-a.name: Aggravated vehicular assault
120.04-a.elements: Engages in reckless driving as defined in VTL §1212 AND commits vehicular assault in the second degree (§120.03) AND: (1) has previously been convicted of operating a motor vehicle while intoxicated/impaired or vehicular assault/manslaughter/homicide offense within the preceding 10 years; OR (2) causes serious physical injury to more than one other person; OR (3) while committing the crime, operates a motor vehicle or vessel while knowing he has a BAC of 0.18 or more; OR (4) while committing the crime, operates a motor vehicle or vessel with a child under 15 as a passenger.

120.05.name: Assault in the second degree
120.05.elements: With intent to cause serious physical injury, causes such injury; OR with intent to cause physical injury, causes such injury by means of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument; OR recklessly causes serious physical injury by means of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument; OR with intent to prevent emergency responder from performing lawful duty, causes physical injury; OR causes physical injury to a person 65+ while actor is under 10 years younger; OR various other enumerated circumstances (e.g., intent to cause injury with caustic chemical, injury to a child under 7 by person over 18, etc.).

120.06.name: Gang assault in the second degree
120.06.elements: With intent to cause physical injury to another person and when aided by two or more other persons actually present, causes serious physical injury to such person or to a third person.

120.07.name: Gang assault in the first degree
120.07.elements: With intent to cause serious physical injury to another person and when aided by two or more other persons actually present, causes serious physical injury to such person or to a third person.

120.08.name: Assault on a peace officer, police officer, firefighter or emergency medical services professional
120.08.elements: With intent to prevent a peace officer, police officer, firefighter, registered nurse or licensed practical nurse, or emergency medical services professional from performing a lawful duty, causes serious physical injury to such officer, firefighter, nurse, or EMS professional.

120.09.name: Assault on a judge
120.09.elements: With intent to prevent a judge from performing a lawful duty, causes physical injury to such judge.

120.09-a.name: Aggravated assault on a judge
120.09-a.elements: With intent to prevent a judge from performing a lawful duty, causes serious physical injury to such judge.

120.10.name: Assault in the first degree
120.10.elements: With intent to cause serious physical injury, causes such injury by means of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument; OR with intent to disfigure another person seriously and permanently, or to destroy, amputate or disable permanently a member or organ of his body, causes such injury; OR under circumstances evincing a depraved indifference to human life, recklessly engages in conduct creating grave risk of death and thereby causes serious physical injury; OR in the course of committing a felony or immediate flight therefrom, causes serious physical injury to a non-participant.

120.11.name: Aggravated assault upon a police officer or a peace officer
120.11.elements: With intent to cause serious physical injury to a police officer or peace officer and with a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument, causes serious physical injury to such officer while the officer is performing an official function.

120.12.name: Aggravated assault upon a person less than eleven years old

120.18.name: Menacing a police officer or peace officer

140.10.name: Criminal trespass in the third degree
140.10.elements: Knowingly enters or remains unlawfully in a building or upon real property that is fenced/enclosed to exclude intruders, or a school/children's camp in violation of posted rules, or a school in violation of a personally communicated request to leave, or a public housing project in violation of posted rules or a request to leave, or a posted no-trespass railroad zone.

140.15.name: Criminal trespass in the second degree
140.15.elements: Knowingly enters or remains unlawfully in a dwelling; OR being a level two or three sex offender required to register under Correction Law art. 6-C, enters or remains in a school knowing the victim of the registration offense attends or formerly attended such school (with affirmative exceptions for lawful students, parents, voting, and authorized entry).

140.17.name: Criminal trespass in the first degree
140.17.elements: Knowingly enters or remains unlawfully in a building, and in the course of committing such crime: (1) possesses, or knows another participant possesses, an explosive or deadly weapon; or (2) possesses a firearm, rifle, or shotgun (as defined in §265.00) with readily accessible ammunition capable of being discharged; or (3) knows another participant possesses such a firearm under subdivision-two circumstances.

140.20.name: Burglary in the third degree
140.20.elements: Knowingly enters or remains unlawfully in a building with intent to commit a crime therein.

140.25.name: Burglary in the second degree
140.25.elements: Knowingly enters or remains unlawfully in a building with intent to commit a crime therein, and (1) in effecting entry, while in the building, or in immediate flight therefrom, the actor or another participant is armed with explosives or a deadly weapon, causes physical injury to a non-participant, uses or threatens the immediate use of a dangerous instrument, or displays what appears to be a pistol, revolver, rifle, shotgun, machine gun, or other firearm; or (2) the building is a dwelling.

140.30.name: Burglary in the first degree
140.30.elements: Knowingly enters or remains unlawfully in a dwelling with intent to commit a crime therein, and in effecting entry, while in the dwelling, or in immediate flight therefrom, the actor or another participant: (1) is armed with explosives or a deadly weapon; or (2) causes physical injury to a non-participant; or (3) uses or threatens the immediate use of a dangerous instrument; or (4) displays what appears to be a pistol, revolver, rifle, shotgun, machine gun, or other firearm (affirmative defense that such firearm was not loaded and capable of producing death or serious physical injury).

140.35.name: Possession of burglar's tools
140.35.elements: Possesses any tool, instrument, or other article adapted, designed, or commonly used for committing or facilitating offenses involving forcible entry into premises, larceny by a physical taking, or theft of services (§165.15 subd. 4-6), under circumstances evincing an intent to use or knowledge that some person intends to use it in committing an offense of such character.

140.40.name: Unlawful possession of radio devices
140.40.elements: Possesses a radio device (any device capable of receiving a wireless voice transmission on any frequency allocated for police use, or any device capable of transmitting and receiving a wireless voice transmission) with intent to use that device in the commission of robbery, burglary, larceny, gambling, or a violation of article two hundred twenty of the penal law.
